name: Image classification
description: Classify a 32x32 RGB image into a closed set of EuroSAT land-use labels.

name: structural text classify
description: Classify plain text into one of email/url/ipv4/uuid/iso_date/plain. Rule-derived; no quality claim.

name: structural text ner
description: Find email/url/ipv4/uuid/iso_date spans in plain text and return start/end offsets. Rule-based; not general NER.

name: text embed (fixed projection)
description: Embed plain text into a 64-dim vector by a fixed-seed projection. No semantic similarity claim.

name: image embed (fixed projection)
description: Embed an image into a 128-dim vector reusing the EuroSAT scratch trunk. No similarity claim.

name: structural table extract
description: Parse a plain-text table into columns/rows with per-column type inference. No table understanding claim.

name: series forecast (scratch)
description: Forecast the next 4 points from the last 24 of a numeric series (CSV or JSON). Trained on synthetic data; no real-series claim.
